visual.description: Deep near-black dark navy that forms the primary background of the entire page.
Slightly lighter dark purple-navy used for surface layers and grid overlay base.
Medium purple used for the grid cross markers pattern overlaid on the dark background.
Dominant warm pink-magenta from the cherry blossom tree filling the hero scene.
Perimeter neon glow ring around the circular scene platform, blue-purple tone.
Bright lavender-purple neon glow accent on architectural elements and light posts.
Near-white with a slight lavender tint used for the handwritten 'CLICK TO START' display text.
Vivid red-orange of the jeep vehicle body, the most saturated warm accent in the scene.
Amber-yellow glow from the jeep headlights, warm highlight accent color.
Sandy warm tan of the circular ground platform the scene sits on.
